entities.summary: Igor Bortnikov is a Russian professional ice hockey forward who currently plays for Neftyanik Almetievsk of the Supreme Hockey League (VHL). He first played in the Kontinental Hockey League with his original youth club, HC Neftekhimik Nizhnekamsk.
